video_title: Full Nikola Jokić Media Day Press Conference | Denver Nuggets

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic plans to sign an extension with the Nuggets next year.
quotes.quote: I am going to sign next year if they want me.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic says he plans to sign an extension with the Denver Nuggets next year, if they want him.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic praises DeMar DeRozan as an underrated passer and potential fit for the Nuggets.
quotes.quote: We know he is a top 20, top 25 player. He can score the ball, that is one thing. But I think he is an underrated passer too. I think we are going to find a way to make him better because he is already great, but I think he is going to love to play with us and play in our style of basketball and maybe he is going to figure out how he can help us and how he can bring some new ideas to our system that we have.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic says DeMar DeRozan is an underrated passer and he is looking forward to seeing how DeRozan fits into the Nuggets style of play.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic says Aaron Gordon is a unique player when healthy.
quotes.quote: When he is injured there is no player in the league like him. There is defenders in the league who can defend really good, but I think the players who can defend from one to five and the offensive side, how he affects the game on offensive side, I think it is literally there is no player in the league when he is healthy.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic says there is no player in the league like Aaron Gordon when he is healthy, citing his ability to defend one through five and impact the game offensively.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic suggests NBA players should play in Europe to experience the pressure.
quotes.quote: I wish every player in NBA should go play like six months in Europe just to see how pressured it is to play. You play Wednesday against Olympiacos in Greece and then you are playing at home against Red Star or Partizan and if you have a three lost in a row it is a big deal over there. People are taking it serious, taking a lot of pride. I really wish that NBA league can play six months as a Europe.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic says he wishes every NBA player would play six months in Europe to experience the pressure and intensity of the fans.
